title: Block Entity Modifier
description: Optional modifier applied to the output block's block-entity data when all predicates in a rule match.

fields.title: Type
fields.description: The kind of block entity modifier.

choices.title: Append Loot
choices.description: Sets a loot table on the output block, so the block in the world will be replaced by a block drawn from that loot table. Requires 'loot_table'.

choices.title: Clear
choices.description: Clears existing block-entity data on the output block.

fields.title: Loot Table
fields.description: Path to the loot table JSON file (used by 'minecraft:append_loot').
